entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need to make a return, please.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. I hear a bit of disappointment in your voice; I'm sorry if your experience hasn't been perfect.
I'm just so let down. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for this new VeloBand. It's just not what I thought it would be.
I understand. To make sure I'm getting you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's just so hard to use. The pulse tracking screen is really confusing, and I can't seem to customize the display the way I want. I really expected more from it.
I see. And have you had a chance to look through the setup guide?

Yes, I read the user manual twice. It still doesn't make sense. I'm just not happy with it, and honestly, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out. I feel a bit guilty for even buying it now.
There's no need to feel guilty. Let's take care of this for you. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the purchase here. You received the VeloBand about 25 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I hope that's not too long.

Not at all. Let me just check the policy... Okay, great news. Our return policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can process this for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried.

It's my pleasure to help. I have approved the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. You'll receive a full refund within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's wonderful. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
